critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2083 — httpx.Timeout(connect=15,read=360,write=60,pool=15) gives long-form Kokoro TTS calls plenty of headroom. Together with the 3-attempt retry on ReadError|ReadTimeout|RemoteProtocolError (2s/4s backoff) this is a textbook fix for the 'Voiceover error: ReadError:' complaint.

server.py L1892 — max_ticks=300 (25 min) for HeyGen polling is a 5x bump from the old 60. Combined with the dynamic progress smoothing (`min(90, 50 + tick*40/max_ticks)`) the UX still feels responsive on the long renders.

server.py L2939 — /studio/ai-previews shares db.flux_cache with the render pipeline so previews are FREE for the eventual render (the cached URL is exactly what gen_image would fetch). No double-charge.

server.py gen_image (L2126-2180) — Flux hardening is tight: num_inference_steps=32 + guidance_scale=4.0 push sharpness/adherence, output_format=png keeps lossless feed into Kling, and the prompt envelope ('Cinematic photograph, 8k, sharp focus' + 'No visible text or signage') is a sensible directive-style negative that Flux Pro 1.1 actually respects.

Pickers.jsx L98-108 — Avatar filter `aspect === 'portrait' || aspect === 'both'` for 9:16 unblocks 622 avatars (vs the strict-portrait-only 27). Comment block correctly notes HeyGen v3's smart cover-crop makes 'both' safe — the iter-15 strict-portrait fix was for v2 and is no longer needed.
Pickers.jsx L833-851 — caption-position-row only renders when `enabled` is true. Clean conditional, position state plumbed through props (position + onPositionChange).

Studio.jsx L745 — chipCaptions label correctly composes 'Captions · {Style} · {Position}'. Default fallback 'Bottom' is the same as the server default, so backend-generated URLs match the chip label even before user interaction.

context_for_next_testing_agent: When running pytest, test_captions_v24.py and test_kling_i2v_v23.py both call os.environ.setdefault('DB_NAME','test_database'). If your test then does load_dotenv('/app/backend/.env') WITHOUT override=True, you'll read 'test_database' from os.environ and write seed data to a DIFFERENT db than the running FastAPI process (which uses f48_studio). Symptom: cache hits silently fail and the endpoint actually calls fal.ai for real (real money). Fix: load_dotenv('/app/backend/.env', override=True) and assert db_name=='f48_studio'. I added the override and the assert to iter-25 tests. Cleaned up 8 polluted TEST_iter25 entries from db.flux_cache that had been created by failed test runs before this fix was in place. Position picker is conditional on `enabled` so the playwright test MUST first click a style card (e.g. captions-tiktok) BEFORE the caption-position-row testid appears in the DOM — picking a style does NOT close the modal, only picking Off does.
rca of the issue: Cross-test env-pollution caused the ai-previews cache assertion to flake. test_captions_v24.py uses os.environ.setdefault('DB_NAME','test_database') which sets DB_NAME for the rest of the process. My test then did load_dotenv() (no override) which leaves the polluted value in place. Seed wrote to test_database.flux_cache; the running server read from f48_studio.flux_cache → cache miss → real fal.ai call. Fixed by load_dotenv(..., override=True) + an explicit assert db_name=='f48_studio'. The bug ONLY surfaces when iter-25 tests run AFTER the v23/v24 suites, not in isolation.
